Create a high-resolution landscape 16:10, straight-on Windows desktop UI DESIGN REFERENCE for DEPTH AI. A completely new visual system called SOFTWARE ANATOMY ATLAS. Spectacular but practical information design, like a precision architectural cutaway atlas of code. NOT a generic dashboard. NO giant marketing headline. Thin top navigation: DEPTH AI, project name, Inspect / Explain / Transform / Assets / Review, Light / Dark, Meta. Compact page title no more than 36px at 1600px screen. Give 85% of screen to useful content. Warm white #F3F1E9, black-green #192827 typography, single burnt-orange #B83F21 selection accent, muted sage and blue structural categories. Very crisp large readable words. One focal selection, generous spacing, consistent alignment. Module forms are physically distinctive flat diagram objects: functions are broad chamfered plates with left/right connection terminals and bold name directly on the plate; state variables are slim cylindrical register bars with value; classes are OPEN CORNER BRACKETS around their members, never a closed card; assets are square photo tiles; views are screen-shaped frames. Light shallow offset underlays may suggest stacked construction but all labels face front. No rounded SaaS cards, no box around every section, no glowing neon or glass, no decorative blobs, no 3D camera scene, no artificial perspective text, no border around explanatory prose. Thin fine smooth directed source relations run through whitespace outside text; only selected trace orange, context charcoal. Common-region spacing and ownership brackets convey containment. The form language must look like an anatomy plate, not a flowchart of identical cards. English app copy. Small footer 'DESIGN REFERENCE'. Do not include fake test successes, live model statuses, or fabricated precision metrics.
Scene 08: 'Inspect / Dependency evidence'. Main LEFT 65% readable sparse source relation drawing, with a selected CalculateTotal function plate receiving two separate incoming arrows from ApplyCoupon and Estimate. CalculateTotal has outgoing references arrow to DiscountPercent state register. Ownership brackets CouponRules, CheckoutController, CartSummary retain meanings. These are static dependency arrows, not runtime steps. RIGHT 35% mathematical notebook with large formula 'B = Pᵀ A P', definitions 'A: entity relationships', 'P: module membership', 'B: aggregated module relationships'. A small matrix specimen labeled 'Illustrative weights', rows and columns visibly named rather than unexplained numbers. Weight legend 'calls 3 · references 2 · contains 0.5' and plain caption 'Engineering weights, not probabilities'. Bottom impact strip 'Changing DiscountPercent affects CalculateTotal and its callers' with exact names and sources. Orange for selected path only, other lines neutral, no giant mesh of links.
Use this NEW reference only for shape/typography/palette consistency; content must follow this scene. No fake source filenames or additional methods. File names and method labels verbatim. Do not add fabricated success statuses.
